# Non-BYZ dedup fallback pulse for Slot 78 (oe_plat_).
# When BYZ scheduler Slot 78 runs first, oe_plat_ran_m == oe_ml_month_now so this trigger short-circuits in O(1).
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_plat_fallback_pulse } }

oe_plat_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_plat_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			AND = { is_ai = no oe_plat_is_host = yes }
			tag = VEN
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } tag = GEN }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_plat_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}
